quizName:
Hardest Questions in Montana
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you?

options.text: It makes you feel overly confident.
It makes it harder to think clearly.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. You may feel more confident or silly. Alcohol also slows your reaction time, hurts your balance, and makes it harder to judge distance and see clearly.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn the direction the arrow points.
These lanes are for buses and carpools only.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: When borrowing an unfamiliar car from a friend, you should:

options.text: Not worry because all cars are the same.
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with the car.
Ignore any problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where controls are and how they work before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where controls are and how they work before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, take time to find and understand the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is prohibited. You cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Not worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: When stopped by police, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must have and show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance when stopped by police.

questions.question: If you are angry when you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play loud music so you stop thinking about it.
Drive fast on the highway to feel better.
Calm down for a few minutes before you start driving.
Stop at a bar for drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down for a few minutes before you start driving.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait until you feel calm before driving. Driving while angry is dangerous and poor judgment.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: Your ability to drive safely can be affected by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving depends on being in good physical condition. Alcohol, medications, and drowsiness can all harm your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: Why is night driving more difficult than day driving?

options.text: You cannot see as far ahead.
Rain is more likely at night.
You are more likely to see motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as far ahead.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far. Always use your headlights. Drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and go a different way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must follow what they say. This sign prohibits passing other vehicles.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, you should:
questions.explanation: Move your vehicle off the road and stop if possible. Call 911 if anyone is hurt and help them. You must report the crash to police if someone is injured, killed, or if there is more than $1,000 in property damage.

questions.question: When should you slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.
For all of the above reasons.

questions.correctAnswerText: For all of the above reasons.
questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections and railroad crossings, on hills, in blind curves, near pedestrians, and on wet or slippery roads.

questions.question: When driving on major highways, you should:

options.text: Be ready to react to road hazards.

questions.explanation: Stay alert and ready to react to unexpected hazards. Avoid looking at one thing for more than a few seconds to prevent highway hypnosis.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Never back up on a freeway or shoulder. Go to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: When you see a stopped school bus with its stop arm out, you should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk and pass on the left.
Keep going when most children have exited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus shows its stop signal. Do not move until the stop arm is pulled in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can turn when it is safe.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Signal 3 to 4 seconds before turning. This gives other drivers time to see your signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver is behind you, you should:

options.text: Stare at the driver as they pass.

questions.explanation: Move out of the way of an aggressive driver. Do not make eye contact. Speeding up may anger them and make things more dangerous.

questions.question: When facing an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Show your disapproval of their driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between your car and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make gestures at them.

questions.question: This sign warns you about:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make 200 decisions per mile. Any extra task takes your focus away from driving and creates danger.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns of a steep downhill road ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: Anything that makes you ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: When you hear an emergency vehicle siren, you must:

options.text: Stop and wait for a green traffic light.
Pull over to the right side of the road.
Speed up and stay out of the way of the emergency vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: You must let emergency vehicles pass. When you see or hear a police car, fire truck, ambulance, or other emergency vehicle with lights and sirens, pull to the right edge of the road as soon as you can.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if you do not see other traffic.
Signal only if there is other traffic nearby.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only when driving in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if you do not see other traffic.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from the curb. Make signaling a habit every time.
